initial_outfit:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the assembled FAT ORANGE CAT with olive tactical helmet and shovel in image1. Image2 is the EXACT HEAD identity to preserve.
Request: redesign ONLY THE CLOTHING AND BOOTS to a more modern ARMY TACTICAL / US special-forces look, staying in the same cute smooth 2D COMIC game style.
New outfit: compact RANGER-GREEN PLATE CARRIER fitted around his fat round torso, wide shoulder straps and MOLLE webbing, 2-3 chunky flat tan/olive magazine/utility pouches on the UPPER chest, small Velcro panels, a simple quick-release tab. Under it a modern olive/coyote combat shirt with short sleeves and broad subdued green/tan/brown organic camouflage patches. Replace the old button-front safari shirt and cream rolled cuffs. Preserve a very wide bulging ROUND BELLY below the chest pouches; the vest must curve with his fat silhouette rather than make a square flat human torso. Keep the belly and short stocky proportions clearly visible.
Lower clothing: olive/coyote tactical battle belt with dark quick-release buckle and webbing, loose STRAIGHT long tactical cargo trousers in subtle matching green/tan camouflage, reinforced seams and visible compact dark olive knee pads with straps, coyote-brown modern combat boots with dark rugged soles and simplified ankle panels/laces. Black/olive fingerless tactical gloves with small knuckle pads and wrist straps; orange fingertips remain visible.
KEEP: same body pose and silhouette, body width, head size, original helmet with side rails and front mount, ears, flat cute squinting eyes, smile, cheeks, orange tabby fur, tail, exact two-handed shovel grip and shovel design. No redesign of head or facial expression. Same camera and 3/4 right-facing viewpoint. No new gun, no backpack or loose gear obscuring the body. No flags, logos or text.
Output: one complete full-body character cutout, fully visible with generous transparent margin, clean bold outlines and warm cel shading matching the reference. Genuine transparent RGBA background, no gray chart background/header, no checkerboard painted in, no ground shadow, no pixel art, no photorealism.
bright_arcade_direction:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
EDIT TARGET: image1, the fat tactical cat carrying a shovel.
STYLE REFERENCES: image2 and image3 are the other two characters in the SAME GAME. Match their cheerful warm colors, bold simple comic outlines, clean cel shading and readable small-scale shapes.
Request: make the TACTICAL OUTFIT brighter, more playful and arcade-like, inspired by the goofy exaggerated military character appeal of Metal Slug, rendered as SMOOTH 2D COMIC rather than pixels.
Palette: warm lively olive / yellow-green fabric, golden khaki pouches and webbing, light coyote-tan boots, warm chocolate-brown reinforced gloves. Increase warmth and color clarity, reduce muddy gray-brown and near-black masses. Use a few LARGE simplified organic camouflage patches; no tiny digital camo pixels, no dense realistic textile grain.
Gear design: keep a modern plate carrier and tactical belt, but simplify into rounded chunky almost toy-like shapes, two large golden-khaki chest pouches, broad clear MOLLE bands, big readable buckles and Velcro flaps. The armor follows a very round soft belly; leave some bulging combat-shirt belly visible below the upper chest rig. Compact rounded knee pads, short stout legs, simplified big combat boots. Fun chibi arcade soldier, cuddly and confident, not grim or realistic.
KEEP EXACTLY: original fat body silhouette and scale, tactical helmet with rails/front mount, cute flat squinting eyes and tiny smile, orange fur and stripes, cream cheeks, ears, tail, head size, two-handed shovel pose and shovel. No new gun or accessories, no darker villain face, no slimmer body, no new background.
Output one full-body complete character cutout with transparent margin. Genuine transparent RGBA, no text/labels, no checkerboard painted in, no ground shadow, no pixel art.
parts:

Image3: established comic game style and color-strength reference.

4 NEAR FOREARM: preserve original orange tabby fur/shape, tactical olive-brown wrist strap instead of old simple cuff.
ROW2:
5 near closed relaxed glove paw, warm brown reinforced tactical glove with small knuckle pads, visible orange fingertips; same pose.
6 near closed GRIPPING glove, wrist LEFT / fingers RIGHT, same palm shape around a shovel shaft.
7 far upperarm matching cell3, same original orientation.
8 far forearm matching cell4.
ROW3:
9 far relaxed tactical glove, same input orientation.
10 far gripping glove, wrist LEFT / fingers RIGHT, same input orientation.
11 NEAR THIGH: olive/khaki camo trouser thigh with cargo Velcro/zip pocket. PRESERVE the existing UNOUTLINED UPPER 20% HIP OVERLAP: plain colored cloth edge, absolutely NO black oval cap/rim at the top. No knee cuff or shorts hem.

ROW4:
